Step 2: mode (1) 'Intensivpflege — ins nasse Haar einmassieren, 3-5 Minuten einwirken lassen, mit warmem Wasser ausspülen' has a stated contact time and a rinse and is framed as the post-wash intensive mode; modes (2) and (3) are explicitly 'nicht ausspülen' and fail the rinse conjunct outright. Step 3: exactly one mode qualifies → mode-scoped classification with a multi_use envelope. Charter F1 names Isana 3in1 as a live boundary case that is eligible mode-scoped.

tailMarker.anomalyNote: No §3.1 anomaly. This is the cohort's longest above-tail segment (15 entries), which makes the product an unusually evidence-rich case: nothing material is demoted to the tail except Tocopherol @23.  ||  PLAUSIBILITY ASSESSMENT (R2, §3.1.1, added under v0.2): PLAUSIBLE. Fifteen above-tail entries carrying the whole architecture (CETEARYL ALCOHOL @2, BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @5, the lipid block @7/@8/@9/@12, STEARAMIDOPROPYL DIMETHYLAMINE @13) all outrank PARFUM @16; conventional O/W emulsion. Neither limb fires. CITRIC ACID @15 is the tail_index - 1 species and carries no signal in any field (it is the amidoamine neutraliser, lexicon C3), so R3's tail-edge exclusion changes nothing here.

dry_combability_potential.note: No silicone at any rank; no dry endpoint.

surface_lubrication_softness_potential.note: Two light esters plus three plant oils plus a cocoa butter, all above the tail.

conditioningLevel.evidenceScope: Formula-only, exact-market DE INCI of record (sha256 12053a7e…), above-tail ranks 1–15; category-relative to the German drugstore rinse-out mask shelf.
conditioningLevel.rationale: All three §9.1 structural signals are satisfied by wide margins inside the cohort's longest above-tail segment. Confidence is held at moderate by the identity gap, not by any weakness in the structural evidence. E2 ceiling: comparative structural intensity potential, not measured treatment performance.
evidenceSignals: BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE (rank 5) and STEARAMIDOPROPYL DIMETHYLAMINE (rank 13) — two distinct cationic species above the tail
CETEARYL ALCOHOL (rank 2) — long-chain fatty alcohol in the top three

DICAPRYLYL ETHER (3), COCOCAPRYLATE (4), COCOS NUCIFERA OIL (7), PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS OIL (8), HELIANTHUS ANNUUS SEED OIL (9), THEOBROMA CACAO SEED BUTTER (12) — six distinct non-fatty-alcohol lipids above the tail
LAURDIMONIUM HYDROXYPROPYL HYDROLYZED WHEAT PROTEIN (rank 10) — a cationised PROTEIN, deliberately NOT counted toward S1 (lexicon family 5a, not family 1)
conditioningLevel.derivation: S1 satisfied (2 distinct cationic surfactants above the tail; the cationised protein at @10 is excluded from the count by family). S2 satisfied (Cetearyl Alcohol @2). S3 satisfied (six distinct non-fatty-alcohol lipids, against a required 2). Count = 3 of 3.
thresholdReasoning: Clears `high`: ≥2 of {S1,S2,S3} with no material counter-signal; all three are met from independent families.
`moderate` does not apply to the VALUE: three signals are satisfied. (Confidence is a separate axis and is held at moderate for identity reasons.)
`low` does not apply: it requires none of the three.

Re-derived under v0.2 (R3): the value `high` STANDS. S1 is satisfied and survives the tail-edge exclusion — BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @5 and STEARAMIDOPROPYL DIMETHYLAMINE @13, two distinct species both ranked above tail_index − 1 (CITRIC ACID @15). S2 is satisfied by CETEARYL ALCOHOL @2 and S3 by six distinct non-fatty-alcohol lipids above the tail. S1 plus both alternatives, with no material counter-signal: the strongest `high` in the cohort under the new rule.
counterSignals: Identity gap: the source page marks the SKU as possibly discontinued. Under G5 this lowers the smallest affected scope — it caps confidence across the profile rather than blocking it.
Isopropyl Alcohol @14 is a carrier with no care meaning (lexicon family 2 note) and earns nothing.
limitations: A three-step concentration scale is at the edge of INCI support.
codecheck-tier source; no dm/Rossmann verbatim page was reachable.

COCOS NUCIFERA OIL (7), PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS OIL (8), HELIANTHUS ANNUUS SEED OIL (9), THEOBROMA CACAO SEED BUTTER (12), DICAPRYLYL ETHER (3), COCOCAPRYLATE (4) — six distinct non-fatty-alcohol lipids: the S3 leg that carried v0.1's `balanced` and that R6 deletes as a path

careDirection.derivation: §9.3 (R6). Material R5 test satisfied on leg (a) (two distinct species above the tail) and independently on leg (b) (a single qualifying species at above-tail rank 6, inside the first eight). `balanced` reading (a) requires a qualifying humectant cluster: fails at one member. `balanced` reading (b) requires no protein anchor: fails at clause 1. → `protein`.
thresholdReasoning: Clears `protein`: a material R5 route on both of its legs, with no qualifying humectant cluster beside it.
`balanced` (a) does not apply: one above-tail humectant against a required three, two of them non-glycerin — and there is no glycerin in the formula at all.
`balanced` (b) does not apply: clause 1 fails on the protein anchor; clause 3 would fail too, on a six-species lipid stack.
`moisture` does not apply: a two-species R5 route above the tail is a protein-film route, which the `moisture` definition excludes.

v0.1 recorded that on the substance `protein` was arguably the more faithful description and that only the S3 lipid leg pushed the value to `balanced`. R6 removes that leg; the value moves for the reason the v0 record predicted.
counterSignals: D4 heavy-protein-payload counter-signal FIRES (two distinct R5 species above the tail, one within the top five ranks of the full list): confidence bound to `moderate`, carried in `hinweise` as `protein_payload`, routed under `protein_payload_review`.

The formula is also genuinely lipid-rich (`weight_potential: high`). `care_direction` is a protein-versus-moisture comparison and says nothing about richness; the richness is said once, in `weight_potential` (§6 rule 1).
Neither R5 species sits near the boundary band, so unlike #04 this value has no tail-edge hinge.
